items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Some comments are present, e.g. "Half-chroma packed RGB (yuv2rgb_1 / _2 / _X, including b005)". But fixed-point constants like 76309, 89830, -22049, 1304898, 175, 221 are written inline with no note tying them to FFmpeg. Names like Y1/U/V/r_off8/sh19_16 are terse, and very large blocks have no comments.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Everything is in one ~117KB src/main.zig. One process function covers several algorithms with deep nesting, the same 4-arm dst_fmt switches are copy-pasted, and special cases (is_1_1/is_1_2/is_2_2) are repeated. .zig-cache and zig-out build artifacts were committed.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The final workspace does not build: the agent edited main.zig at step 150 and timed out without rebuilding, and hidden test build_ok failed. Magic constants are spread throughout, and `else => unreachable` is used where an error return would be safer.

items.name: Geometry, stride and tail handling

items.evidence: There are scalar tails (`while (i < halfW)`), and the SIMD path requires `(dstW & 1) == 0`. But the submitted library does not build, so no geometry works. Stride handling on every plane cannot be checked.
